stem: At shift end, three issues remain open: a contained irrigation fault, an unresolved label discrepancy, and a completed sanitation deviation awaiting supervisor review. What is the strongest handoff?
choices: List each issue with scope, current control/status, actions completed, evidence or work-order identifiers, responsible follow-up, and priority for the next shift
Tell the next shift that several things need attention
Close all records so the shift appears complete
Combine the three issues into one generic note
rationale: A professional handoff makes open work actionable by preserving identity, status, evidence, ownership, and priority for each issue.
